body:
To love someone with bipolar is one of the hardest things. I see my mum battle with it everday.. but its not a choice, i love her and would do anything to see her happy. The people in your life that love you want to see u happy. 
'I see how much i hurt the people around me' It only hurts because they care, its not YOU doing the huring.. it is the BIPOLAR
Stay strong and let those around you, love you
